prediction.note: GP continuation; x/y independent; a turn is not predictable from the path

metrics.heading_note: degrees, 0 = world +X, 90 = world +Y (counter-clockwise seen from above)

gaze.note: head direction from nose/eyes/ears (not eye gaze); sd_deg per frame, never below 15 deg

source: demo: stock clip fog.mp4, camera calibrated from the walker (1.75 m, hfov 55.0 deg assumed)

cutouts.note: flat cards facing the camera; exact only from the camera's viewpoint

ground.note: flat ground; anything standing up is smeared onto the ground or the backdrop
